name: jr-read-cap
description: Stops Claude from reading a long file whole: a Read of a file over 1,000 lines without a range is refused with a hint to grep first and read only the lines it needs. Saves context and tokens.

maxLines.title: Line cap
maxLines.description: Whole-file reads of files longer than this are refused (minimum 50).

respectAllowLarge.title: Let explicit large reads through
respectAllowLarge.description: When Claude marks a Read as deliberately large (allow_large), let it pass.
